# UX Requirements Checklist: Family School Dashboard

**Purpose**: Check that the specification states the parent-facing behavior clearly enough to build and review the screens
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Child switcher

- [ ] CHK001 The spec states that every screen offers one child or Both, and what Both includes
- [ ] CHK002 The spec states how a shared communication or event is labeled versus a private one
- [ ] CHK003 The spec states what a selected child hides from the other child
- [ ] CHK004 Requirements for an unknown child id are testable, including what still appears

## Upcoming and recent

- [ ] CHK005 The upcoming window names the first included date and the first excluded later date
- [ ] CHK006 Requirements state that yesterday is absent from upcoming and still listed on its own screen
- [ ] CHK007 The home view states how upcoming items are ordered
- [ ] CHK008 The recent communications list states a count and that it is not limited to the upcoming window

## Forms and destructive actions

- [ ] CHK009 Each record type lists required fields and what the parent sees when one is missing
- [ ] CHK010 Delete requirements require a confirmation and state that cancel leaves the record
- [ ] CHK011 Empty household requirements name both adding a child and loading sample data
- [ ] CHK012 The two-child cap and blank-name rejection are stated as observable outcomes

## Grades, events, and sample data

- [ ] CHK013 Grade requirements state that the entered text is stored as typed and how "latest" is chosen
- [ ] CHK014 Field-trip requirements state when destination and the permission or items note are shown
- [ ] CHK015 Sample-data requirements name the fictional records and forbid a second copy and an automatic load

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
